page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, each of the 32 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core, ensuring dedicated compute allocation without hyper-threading.

The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

The lack of local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, making this instance unsuitable for workloads requiring local high-speed scratch space or hardware acceleration. However, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make it highly efficient for general-purpose enterprise workloads, web serving, application servers, and moderate database hosting where consistent compute performance is required.
